400 Bad Request error when OCR input has an invalid image format

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
  client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = client.ocr_async(LiterLlm::OcrRequest.new(document: { 'type' => 'document_url', 'url' => 'invalid://url' }, model: 'mistral/mistral-ocr-latest'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
